artifacts.summary: Confirms the head-1 marker-selection defect in subagent-postflight.sh and the identical independent defect in events-log-lifecycle.sh; establishes that $CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID (already exported into every Bash tool call, same id space as hook stdin .session_id) is the correlation key; recommends adding a cc_session_id field to the marker schema written by skill_create_postflight_marker and having find_marker() select only the marker matching the stopping session's own cc_session_id, never falling back to an arbitrary marker; flags that events-log-lifecycle.sh must also be touched to satisfy the events.jsonl attribution acceptance criterion, which is outside the delegation's stated two-file SOURCE-STORE RULE.

memory_candidates.content: Claude Code exports $CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID into every Bash tool invocation within a session -- the same id space as hook stdin's top-level .session_id field (Claude Code's native session UUID, documented in events-format.md as cc_session_id). A script running as a Bash tool call can read this directly without needing a hook to capture it first. Prior art: update-task-status.sh keys its workflow-active-<key> marker by ${CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID:-$session_id}; the memory extension's bootstrap-harvest scripts treat it as a hard FATAL-if-unset requirement for self-exclusion.

subagent-postflight.sh and events-log-lifecycle.sh each independently implement `find specs -maxdepth 3 -name ".postflight-pending" | head -1` marker selection. They are separate code paths with separate MARKER_FILE variables -- fixing one does not fix the other. Any future defect or enhancement touching one hook's marker-selection logic must check the other for the identical pattern; postflight-control.md's 'Consistency Between the Two Hooks on a Malformed Marker' section is the established precedent for fixing both together.

test-postflight-marker-schema.sh asserts an EXACT key set (EXPECTED_KEYS) for the .postflight-pending marker schema produced by skill_create_postflight_marker in skill-base.sh. Any change that adds a field to that marker (e.g. a new cc_session_id correlation field) will fail this test's exact-key-set assertion unless the test is updated in the same change -- a mechanical but easy-to-miss follow-up.

context_gaps.gap: The two-id-spaces explanation (agent-system session_id vs. Claude Code's native session UUID / $CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID / cc_session_id) is re-derived in comments across update-task-status.sh, wezterm-preflight-status.sh, events-log-lifecycle.sh, and events-format.md rather than living in one canonical doc.
context_gaps.recommendation: Non-blocking for this task; a future /meta pass could add context/patterns/cc-session-correlation.md centralizing this, mirroring postflight-control.md's role for the marker-file protocol.
